summary: Task 1 lays down the project foundation cleanly: three AppException factories (notFound, unprocessableEntity, conflict overload) are added without disturbing the existing API surface; the new com.botfunnel.project package (entity + repository + 3 DTOs + ValidTimezone + 8 validator tests) follows the documented patterns (ValidPassword shape, UpdateProfileRequest mass-assignment defense, User.java getter/setter style); config and env scaffolding are in place. Compilation and ValidTimezoneValidatorTest pass green. No critical or major findings; only minor test-redundancy and comment-style notes.

suggestions.suggestion: The @ParameterizedTest offset_or_invalid_returns_false (lines 23-32) duplicates coverage of the four individual @Test methods that follow (offset_format_gmt5_returns_false, offset_format_plus_0200_returns_false, abbreviation_ut_returns_false, nonexistent_zone_returns_false on lines 35-52). The TDD anchor mandates the four named cases; the parameterized version asserts the same inputs/outputs with the same validator. Either drop the parameterized variant or consolidate the four named cases into it (preferring the parameterized form would require reframing the TDD anchor — the named-case approach is what the task pinned, so removing the @ParameterizedTest is the lower-risk cleanup).
suggestions.benefit: Removes ~10 lines of duplicate assertions, eliminates a divergence risk if the IANA-vs-offset list ever changes (you'd have to update two places), and keeps the test class aligned 1:1 with the named TDD anchor cases.

suggestions.suggestion: The new production-index-note comment correctly reflects current config (auto-index-creation=true). Note for follow-up: User.java:10-11 and Event.java:10-11 still claim `auto-index-creation=false` while application.properties has it set to `true` — those comments are stale relative to the live config. Out of scope for this task (per Task 1 description, existing entities stay untouched), but worth flagging for a future cleanup task or for the decisions.md write-up so the divergence between Project.java's comment and the legacy entities' comments is documented intentionally.
suggestions.benefit: Prevents future readers from being confused by two contradictory comment styles in the same package.

suggestions.suggestion: ValidTimezoneValidator uses tz.isBlank() while ValidPasswordValidator uses password.isEmpty(). For ValidTimezone the choice is correct (whitespace-only timezone is meaningless and @NotBlank on CreateProjectRequest.timezone owns the message), but the divergence from the cited precedent is slightly surprising at a glance. Either keep as-is and add a one-line note (`// .isBlank() not .isEmpty(): a whitespace-only timezone is also a no-op and should delegate to @NotBlank`) or align with isEmpty(). Keeping isBlank() is the better engineering choice — just document the divergence for the next reader.
suggestions.benefit: Removes a surprise for someone reading both validators side-by-side; makes the deliberate choice visible.
